degree_eight_capability_example.proof: Each normalized row obeys sum_j B_ij^2 >= 1/3. Equality requires B_ij=1/3; the Fourier matrix is unitary and attains it.
degree_eight_capability_example.scope: Shows a CP-even higher-degree orientation potential can select nonzero |J| with conjugate CP partners. Other degree-eight invariants have independent coefficients under the declared symmetry; no UV generation of this coefficient pattern is supplied.
